authorization_grant.permitted_next_action: A separately assigned outcome acquirer may retrieve exactly the identified FY2024 original annual-report PDF and apply only the four frozen V2 resolution cells.
not_authorized: Selecting a report summary, a revision, or any different annual-report document as a substitute.
Changing a frozen field, arithmetic rule, threshold, comparison baseline, local-unknown treatment, or judgment treatment.
Using market-price, return, analyst, valuation-number, or investment-action material.

excluded_metadata_records.exclusion_reason: Summary; not the original full annual report.
Revision; not the originally published FY2024 full annual report.

official_cninfo_metadata_source.selection_rule: The selected record is the sole FY2024 metadata record titled exactly 2024年年度报告. The same-day summary and subsequent revision are explicitly excluded.

prerequisites.required_state: judgment_status = FROZEN_PRE_OUTCOME; its V2 resolution contract remains unchanged.
Verdict ACCEPT and Outcome access may be authorized YES.

prerequisites.requirement: Document identity checked before body access
prerequisites.required_state: The acquirer must retrieve only announcement ID 1223421477, titled 2024年年度报告, dated 2025-04-30, at the stated static CNINFO URL.
The outcome acquirer must not influence candidate selection or alter the pre-outcome judgment; a later feedback role may compare the frozen judgment and mechanically resolved outcome only.

required_fields: FY2024 actual 电池对外销售 in GW
FY2024 actual total 组件出货 in GW
frozen_resolution_cells.arithmetic_and_threshold: S1_GW = 电池对外销售_GW + 组件出货_GW; compare only with 90.00GW.
frozen_resolution_cells.fixed_resolution: S1_GW >= 90.00 is AT_LEAST_90GW and upward for only the volume-realization leg of J1; S1_GW < 90.00 is BELOW_90GW and downward; an absent, non-GW, non-actual, or external-sales-only module figure is UNKNOWN_UNAVAILABLE_OR_NONCOMPARABLE and leaves J1 unchanged.

required_fields: Consolidated 主营业务分产品情况 row exactly named 组件及电池: 营业收入
Consolidated 主营业务分产品情况 row exactly named 组件及电池: 营业成本
frozen_resolution_cells.arithmetic_and_threshold: R2 = revenue; C2 = cost; M2_pct = ((R2 - C2) / R2) * 100 when R2 > 0. Revenue expands only if R2 > RMB99,199,497,228.50; margin meets threshold only if M2_pct >= 18.38.
frozen_resolution_cells.fixed_resolution: Margin at or above 18.38 with expanded revenue is upward; margin at or above 18.38 with positive non-expanded revenue is unchanged; margin below 18.38 with expanded revenue is downward; margin below 18.38 or zero revenue with non-expanded revenue is downward. An absent or non-comparable exact consolidated row is UNKNOWN_UNAVAILABLE_OR_NONCOMPARABLE and leaves J2 unchanged.
prohibited_substitutes: differently named, broader, or narrower category

required_fields: Consolidated cash-flow statement: 经营活动产生的现金流量净额
Consolidated cash-flow statement: 购建固定资产、无形资产和其他长期资产支付的现金
frozen_resolution_cells.arithmetic_and_threshold: S3_RMB = operating cash flow - cash paid for fixed, intangible, and other long-lived assets. S3_RMB >= 0 is CASH_CAPEX_COVERED; S3_RMB < 0 is CASH_CAPEX_NOT_COVERED.
frozen_resolution_cells.fixed_resolution: This is a reproducible owner-cash screen, not precise free cash flow. Its J3 treatment is determined only by the frozen joint map with CELL_4. If either specified consolidated line is unavailable, the cell is UNKNOWN_UNAVAILABLE_OR_NONCOMPARABLE and J3 remains unchanged.

required_fields: Note 43: 1年内到期的长期借款, 应付债券, and 租赁负债
Non-current balance-sheet 长期借款, 应付债券, and 租赁负债 net of those current portions
Note 72 current-period 存货跌价损失及合同履约成本减值损失
Note 72 current-period 固定资产减值损失
frozen_resolution_cells.arithmetic_and_threshold: B4_RMB = 货币资金 - (the seven specified financing components). BUFFER_INTACT if B4_RMB >= RMB30,308,853,390.43; otherwise BUFFER_WEAKENED. I4_RMB = the two specified Note 72 losses. MATERIAL_IMPAIRMENT if I4_RMB >= RMB1,351,416,111.91; otherwise BELOW_MATERIAL.
frozen_resolution_cells.fixed_resolution: Together with CELL_3, apply the complete eight-row V2 J3 joint map only. If any listed financing component, a required Note 43 current portion, or either Note 72 loss is unavailable, the cell is UNKNOWN_UNAVAILABLE_OR_NONCOMPARABLE and J3 remains unchanged.
prohibited_substitutes: aggregate 一年内到期的非流动负债
differently scoped balance-sheet or impairment measure

fresh_custodian_role.authority: Locate and freeze one official source identity through CNINFO metadata only.
fresh_custodian_role.handoff_recipient: Separately assigned outcome acquirer and mechanical-cell resolver.
fresh_custodian_role.authority_boundary: This custodian may authorize document acquisition but may not extract, summarize, interpret, or compare body facts.

local_mismatch.condition: The preserved pre-outcome artifacts treat FY2024 only as a future outcome and do not supply the official FY2024 original-report identity.
local_mismatch.resolution: The fresh official CNINFO metadata identity above is the sole authorized source locator. No local FY2024 report, text extraction, cached copy, summary, or revision is treated as a substitute or consulted by this custodian.
local_mismatch.next_role_control: Before reading a body, the outcome acquirer must match the retrieved item to the title, date, announcement ID, and static URL in this authorization.
